description: This file defines an API endpoint class 'AuthenticateEndpoint' responsible for user authentication in a web application. It handles HTTP POST requests for authentication, utilizes SignInManager for sign-in logic, and generates a JWT token via ITokenClaimsService upon successful login.

classes.name: AuthenticateEndpoint
classes.description: An API endpoint for authenticating users by verifying credentials and issuing JWT tokens.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the POST request for user authentication, interacts with SignInManager and TokenClaimsService, and returns an authentication response.
